post.summary: stepSimulatedClock
post.description: Testing only (road-fixes-clock-spec.md §7). Advances or sets the shared simulated clock, gated entirely on the server's own DHASHU_SIMULATED_CLOCK setting — never on anything the client sends. Disabled and inert whenever that setting is off; production always derives the clock from real time. Provide exactly one of advance_hours or the week/day/hour trio.

advance_hours.description: Move the shared clock forward (or back, if negative) this many hours.

get.description: Date-scoped operation. GET has no transitions. Feedback opens one hour after the stored date (rounded up to the simulator hour) and closes on the next simulation week. Only own private feedback is returned. Exact recorded retries are safe; changed/stale submissions conflict. No-show is an unverified report and releases the pair without a punitive strike. Cancellation may assess a pending fee but never collects money. Timeout reconciliation is explicit and idempotent.

simulated_clock.description: Server simulation mode. Manual stepping is forbidden when accelerated_test or async_rehearsal is enabled.

accelerated_test.description: Null unless the operator enabled the shared three-minute test timetable. Read-only metadata; no client can start or reset a run. See docs/accelerated-beta-walkthrough.md.

AsyncRehearsal.description: Opt-in action-driven Dating rehearsal. Null when disabled. No elapsed-time expiry or automatic reset. See docs/async-rehearsal.md.

start_request.description: POST automatically on authenticated app entry when present; never from rendering.

draft_availability.description: Own valid_slots, my_slots and PUT path, available at minute 12 before matching.
